title: Insurance accepted. Uninsured welcome. Membership available.

media.alt: Slide 1 of 5, deep green, with the Ellenton Family Practice Direct logo at the top left, the small heading Three ways to be seen, the headline Insurance accepted. Uninsured welcome., the line Membership available., the word Swipe, and familypracticedirect.com at the foot.

Slide 2 of 5, sand colored, with the logo at the top left, the heading We accept insurance., and three lines: Physicals, sick visits and chronic care. Bring your insurance card and a photo ID. Call to ask how your plan works here. familypracticedirect.com at the foot.

Slide 3 of 5: a photo of the practice's roadside sign, reading Ellenton Family Practice Direct and Family Medicine, on a grassy lot under a blue sky, above the words No insurance? You are still seen. Call and we will explain how it works. The logo and familypracticedirect.com sit at the foot.

Slide 4 of 5, deep green, with the logo at the top left, the heading Or a membership, if it suits you., and four lines: One flat monthly fee. Longer visits. Same or next day access for members. Month to month, no contract. familypracticedirect.com at the foot.

Slide 5 of 5, sand colored, with the logo at the top left, the headline Whichever fits, start with a call., the line Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM., an amber Call 941 417 7386 button, and familypracticedirect.com at the foot.
